faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.desc: Find quick answers regarding application procedures, requirements, and selection.
faq.q1: When does admissions open and how do I apply?
faq.a1: Applications open online from May 1 to June 20, 2026 via the 'Apply Now' button on this portal.
faq.q2: How many majors can an applicant choose?
faq.a2: Applicants can choose up to 2 majors (Priority 1 and Alternative 2).
faq.q3: How does the selection and scoring system work?
faq.a3: Selection uses an automated formula: (Average Report Sem. 1-5 × 70%) + (Achievement Points × 30%).
faq.q4: Is there any fee for registration?
faq.a4: SPMB registration is 100% FREE without any application fees.
faq.a5: 3x4 photo, scanned diploma/certificate, scanned Family Card, 5 semesters report cards, and certificates.
faq.q6: How do I check results and print proof of registration?
faq.a6: Use your official registration number (e.g., REG-2026-XXXXX) in the 'Check Status' menu to view status and download the PDF card.
